news.headline: Nifty reclaims 25,000 as rally extends to 7th session; Sensex +1,718
news.what_happened: Nifty 50 closed at 25,030 (+2.01%) and Sensex at 81,028 (+2.17%) on Friday, led by banks, on foreign inflows and softer crude.
news.why_it_matters: Seven-day run raises the odds of profit-taking; entries at the open carry gap risk.

news.headline: Wall Street rebounds after sharp AI-regulation selloff; strong US jobs
news.what_happened: Nasdaq +1.09% and S&P 500 +0.31% Friday, recovering part of Thursday's 5.5%/4.4% drop; Dow -0.5%. October payrolls +165K vs 65K expected, unemployment 4.1%. US 10Y at 4.86%.
news.why_it_matters: Rebound is partial and volatile (VIX ~25.6); a strong labour market tempers Fed-cut hopes.

news.headline: Gold +1.6%, silver +2.7% overnight
news.what_happened: Gold futures rose to about $4,139/oz and silver to $53.3.
news.why_it_matters: Higher gold lifts collateral value for gold-loan NBFCs.

news.headline: Asia firm: Nikkei +3.4%, Hang Seng +0.5%
news.what_happened: Japan's Nikkei jumped about 3.4% and Hang Seng gained about 0.5% per Yahoo Finance data.
news.why_it_matters: Broader regional risk-on supports Indian sentiment.

sector_outlook.reason: Banks led Friday's rally; strong FII inflows
Nasdaq rebound only partial; rupee flat
Asia firm, no fresh China data

picks.logic: Gold loans are collateralised by gold; a sharp rise lifts collateral values and sentiment for gold-loan NBFCs. Reference: prev close 2855.
